title: Good product for the price
text: Good product for the price. So, I purchased this because my neck was bothering me and I thought it might help. I have been using it for a while now, and it seems to help. However, this is definitely not for side or stomach sleeping which is a little inconvenient if you want to switch positions at night. And the material is maybe a little too soft, as my head/neck squishes it down and it seems to lose a little support. The two bumps are different levels of neck support on each side, although, I think the small side is a total loss as it is too small to actually provide support. Overall a pretty good pillow though.

product_metadata.title: Bedsure Contour Memory Foam Pillow - Orthopedic Cervical Pillows for Neck Pain with Cooling Nylon Cover - Breathable Neck Soft Pillow for Side, Back Sleepers (Standard, 24x13x4/3.5 inches)
features: Two-Layer Foam: CertiPUR-US qualified memory foam on top of this ergonomic pillow offers a soft feel, while high resilience foam on the back ensures excellent recovery and the right amount of bounce.

For Back Sleepers: Ventilation holes are large and dense in the middle of the pillows for sleeping, resulting in more breathability than a conventional pillow and a soft feel for back sleepers for a deep sleep.
For Side Sleepers: Well-placed ventilation holes around the middle are tiny and sparse, making the contoured pillow relatively supportive, if you prefer to sleep on your side.

Breathable Cover: Ventilation holes on both sides of the sleeping pillow help improve heat transfer; polyester cover mixed with 39% nylon fabric with air mesh design makes it more breathable and cooling.

Washable Cover: Machine wash the cover of the cervical pillow in cold water, separately; tumble dry low; a washable cover helps you keep the pillows clean and durable to use; OEKO-TEX 100 qualified to meet the standard.
